# Terms of Service

The legal documents that govern how candidates and companies use the Jack & Jill platform, plus how we share data and what counts as acceptable use of the website.

## Platform Terms (US)

Terms that govern new US companies using Jill: Plans and Jill Slots, what a subscription includes, and your obligations as a hirer.

Save as PDF Print

**Effective date:** 24 August 2026

Welcome to Jack & Jill, operated by Tinker Tailor Talent Limited ("Jack & Jill", "we", "us" or "our"). These Platform Terms ("Terms") govern your use of the Platform and our hirer-facing services, including Jill, our AI headhunter. By using the Platform, by purchasing or continuing a Plan, or by interviewing or working with a Job Seeker we Introduced to you, you agree to these Terms.

These Terms constitute a legally binding contract between Jack & Jill and the organisation you represent ("Hirer", "you" or "your"). You promise us that you are authorised on behalf of the organisation you represent to enter into these Terms on their behalf, including to incur recurring charges on its behalf.

It is important to read these Terms carefully, especially sections 4 (Our obligations), 5 (Fees, including how a Plan renews, how you cancel, and how we can change your Pricing Model), 6 (Pre-existing Candidates), 7 (Your obligations), 13 (Indemnity for your breaches of these Terms), 14 (Liability) and 17 (Only these Terms apply).

Capitalised words in these Terms have the meaning explained in section 21 (Definitions) or in the sentence where that word is defined.

## 1\. About us

**Legal Entity:** Tinker Tailor Talent Limited is a company registered in England and Wales with Company No. 16324763 and a registered address at 86-90 Paul Street, London, England, EC2A 4NE.

**Our Contact Details:** [legal@jackandjill.ai](mailto:legal@jackandjill.ai)

**Brand Name:** "Jack & Jill" is our operating brand. Any references to "Jack & Jill" are references to Tinker Tailor Talent Limited.

## 2\. Hirers only

These Terms apply only to Hirers looking to Engage Job Seekers. If you are a Job Seeker looking for a job or other opportunity the Job Seeker terms apply to your use of the Platform, including Jack, our AI recruiter.

**Which pricing applies to you:** we offer two Pricing Models. Hirers who buy a Plan through the Platform pay a Subscription Fee under section 5A, and owe no Success Fee. Hirers who are not on a Plan do not pay a Subscription Fee but will pay a Success Fee when they Engage a Job Seeker we Introduced, under section 5B. Your account page states which Pricing Model applies to you at any time, and it is the record we will both rely on. We may move your account between the two Pricing Models, on the terms set out in section 5D.

**Existing agreements are unaffected:** if you agreed to a previous version of these Terms, the pricing you accepted continues to apply to your account until you buy a Plan, until we change your Pricing Model under section 5D, or until we agree otherwise in writing. Prices we publish on our website apply to new orders and are not an offer to vary an existing agreement. Moving to a Plan takes effect only when you buy one and applies to Engagements arising from Introductions made after that date.

## 3\. How does Jack & Jill work?

**Platform:** Jack & Jill provides AI-driven recruitment and job-search assistance by identifying suitable roles for Job Seekers and making Introductions to prospective employers like you.

**Jack:** Jack is our AI recruiter that Job Seekers interact with to find jobs at the hottest companies. Jack also has a career coach mode that works with Job Seekers like a mentor. You will not interact with Jack on our Platform because Jack only interacts with Job Seekers.

**Jill:** Jill is our AI headhunter that helps organisations like yours find exceptional talent among our Job Seekers faster and cheaper than agency recruiters. You will interact with Jill when using our Platform. You will need to create an account and agree to these Terms before you can use the Platform.

**What a Slot is, commercially:** where you have a Plan it is made up of Jill Slots. One Slot corresponds to one role worked by one Jill. Your Plan states how many Slots you have. You may move the Slot to a different role once you close or pause the role currently being worked on in the Slot.

## 4\. Our obligations

**Scope of our services:** We provide access to the Platform (including Jill) to you and identify Job Seekers for your open roles. We do this by using AI-powered tooling to analyse Your Information and leverage our network and expertise to generate lists of Job Seekers who would be a great fit for your team.

**Scope of a Plan:** where you are on a Plan, our primary obligation is to make the Platform and the number of Jill Slots in your Plan available to you, together with the Usage Allowances that Plan includes. We do not promise a specific number of Introductions, accepted Introductions, interviews or hires, and a Plan does not amount to a guarantee that any role will be filled. We do not offer a service level agreement or availability credits on a Plan.

**Sourcing (Public Profiles):** We also make available a search tool that enables you to search for and identify prospective candidates through the Platform ("Sourcing" feature). Any individual identified through Sourcing is a "Sourced Candidate".

A Sourced Candidate is not a Job Seeker and is not Introduced to you for the purposes of these Terms. The viewing or interaction with a Sourced Candidate through Sourcing does not constitute an Introduction, and where you are not on a Plan it does not give rise to any Success Fee.

A Sourced Candidate becomes a Job Seeker only if and when that individual independently joins the Platform and is accepted as a Job Seeker in accordance with the applicable Job Seeker Terms. In the event that a Sourced Candidate becomes a Job Seeker, the remaining provisions of these Terms shall apply in full (including those provisions relating to Success Fee and Pre-existing Candidates where an Introduction is made, where those provisions apply to you).

**Our Platform is otherwise provided "as is":** To the fullest extent permitted by law, all implied terms, conditions, representations and warranties (including any in respect of quality, accuracy, ability to achieve a particular result, title, non-infringement, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose or that might otherwise arise because of our dealings or usage of trade) will be excluded from these Terms.

The Platform is provided over the internet, and as such, the quality and availability of such may be affected by factors beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to network interruptions, third party service failures, or other unforeseen technical issues. However, we will use reasonable endeavours to make the Platform available at all times except for any planned maintenance.

**No guarantee about accuracy:** Due to the nature of large language models and AI technologies, Jill may occasionally "hallucinate" and produce Suggestions which are inaccurate or speculative. The Suggestions should not be treated as definitive professional advice. We are not responsible for reviewing or attempting to verify the accuracy or completeness of any Suggestion. You are responsible for all decisions or actions taken based on any Suggestion.

**No screening of Job Seekers:** We do not carry out, and shall have no obligation to carry out, any background checks, reference checks, qualification verification, criminal record checks, right to work checks, or any other screening in relation to the Job Seekers. We do not make any representation or warranty as to the accuracy, completeness or reliability of the information provided by any Job Seeker.

You understand and agree that you are solely responsible for carrying out all checks you consider necessary before Engaging a Job Seeker. We shall not be liable for any failure by you to verify a Job Seeker or for any reliance placed on unverified information.

## 5\. Fees

Section 5A applies if you are on a Plan. Section 5B applies if you are not. Section 5C applies to both.

### 5A. Subscription Fees (Hirers on a Plan)

**No Success Fee:** while you are on a Plan, you owe us no Success Fee for Engaging a Job Seeker we Introduced to you, however many Job Seekers you Engage and whatever they are paid. You are not required to disclose a Job Seeker's compensation to us, and no refund, clawback or rebate arises when an Engagement ends.

**Plans and Slots:** a Plan is a subscription to a stated number of Jill Slots at the price published on our website when you buy or last changed the Plan. One Slot entitles you to one role at a time, worked by one Jill.

**What you pay and when:** the Subscription Fee for your Plan is payable in advance, in US dollars, for each Billing Period. A Billing Period is monthly or annual, as stated at checkout. Your first Billing Period begins on the day you buy the Plan, and each later Billing Period begins on the same day of the following month or year. Where that day does not exist in a given month, it begins on the last day of that month.

**Automatic renewal:** your Plan renews automatically at the end of each Billing Period, and we will charge your payment method for the next Billing Period on the day it begins, until you cancel. You are authorising a recurring charge, not a single payment. On an annual Plan we will also email you at least thirty (30) days before the term renews, telling you the renewal date and the amount we will charge.

**Annual Plans:** an annual Plan is paid in advance for a twelve (12) month term at the discounted price published on our website. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the term rather than at the end of a month. There is no refund for unused months. Usage Allowances are specific to each month and do not pool or roll over across the year. Any usage above the Usage Allowance will be invoiced monthly in arrears.

**Adding a Slot part-way through a Billing Period:** you may add Slots at any time, either on a monthly or an annual Plan. A Slot is charged pro rata for the time remaining in that Billing Period, which on a monthly Plan means the rest of the Billing Period at the monthly rate, and on an annual Plan means the rest of the term at the annual rate. We invoice that additional amount in arrears at the end of the calendar month you added it in, and the Slot is thereafter included in your Subscription Fee from your next Billing Period onwards, so that a Slot added mid-term will then renew with the rest of your Plan rather than on the date it was added. It also adds a pro-rata Usage Allowance immediately for the days remaining in the current calendar month, rounded up to the nearest whole Intro Request and Profile View, with the full monthly allowance from the next month onwards.

**Usage Allowances:** each Plan includes a monthly Usage Allowance for Intro Requests and Profile Views, as published on our website. Allowances are pooled across your account rather than tied to a particular Slot, Jill or user, are calculated per calendar month, and do not roll over. Unused allowance is not refundable and has no cash or credit value.

**Overage:** if you exceed a Usage Allowance we may either decline the request or supply it and invoice you for it in arrears at the Overage Rate published on our website. The Overage Rate is higher than the equivalent rate for allowance included in your Plan, and we show it in the Platform before you exceed an allowance. We will not charge overage for an allowance we did not tell you that you had passed.

**Monitoring and alerts:** we monitor usage on your account, including Intro Requests, Profile Views and the compute Jill consumes on your behalf. We may notify you when that usage is unusual for your Plan, and if it continues we may decline further requests, restrict Jill's activity, or suspend it completely. This monitoring is how we give you the notice promised above, and it is also how we protect Job Seekers from repetitive contact.

**Reducing your Plan:** on a monthly Plan you may reduce the number of Slots at any time. A reduction takes effect at the start of your next Billing Period, and you keep the Slots you have paid for until then. We do not reduce a Plan automatically because you used less than you bought, and we do not refund a Billing Period you have already paid for. On an annual Plan, reductions take effect at the end of the term.

**Cancellation:** you may cancel your Plan at any time from your account settings, without contacting us and without giving a reason. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the Billing Period you have paid for, which on an annual Plan is the end of the term, and your Plan does not renew. We do not give partial refunds for a Billing Period in progress. Your statutory rights are unaffected.

**Making a role inactive:** if you make a role inactive, pause it or close it, we cancel every pending Intro Request and every pending Expression of Interest for that role, and we tell the affected Job Seekers that the role is no longer being hired for. Allowance already spent on a cancelled Intro Request is not restored, refunded or credited, because the request was made and a Job Seeker's attention was spent on it. The same applies when you reduce your Plan, when you cancel it, and when we suspend it for non-payment.

**Capacity and fair use:** the Platform runs on third-party AI models that cost us money to run, and each account has an internal compute ceiling. Where your use materially exceeds normal use for your Plan, we may restrict or suspend Jill's activity on your account and will contact you to agree how to proceed. We will not suspend an account under this clause without notice except where necessary to protect the integrity of the Platform or the personal interests of a Job Seeker.

**Price changes:** we may change the price of a Plan, the Usage Allowances it includes or the Overage Rate at any time and for any reason, on thirty (30) days notice. We will tell you in writing, and the change takes effect at the start of the first Billing Period that begins at least thirty (30) days after we send that notice. On an annual Plan the change takes effect at the start of your next term, which means a price you have paid a year in advance will remain as agreed for that year. You may cancel under this section before the change takes effect, and if you keep using the Platform after it does, the new price applies.

**Free tier:** we may offer a free tier with a reduced number of Slots and a reduced Usage Allowance, at our sole discretion. On the free tier, allowances are hard caps: when you reach one we decline further Intro Requests or searches rather than charging you for overage, and a declined request or search is not a failure of the Platform. A free tier is provided as is, and we may change or withdraw it at any time on written notice. Sections 5B and 6 do not apply to a free tier, and no Success Fee arises from an Introduction made on it.

### 5B. Success Fees (Hirers not on a Plan)

**Success Fee:** If we make an Introduction to a Job Seeker and you or an Affiliate Engage the Job Seeker within twelve (12) months of the Introduction, you will pay us a success fee.

References to a "Success Fee" mean the success fee payable in respect of the engagement of a Job Seeker as an employee or contractor, as applicable.

**Success fee (employees):** **Calculation:** If the Job Seeker becomes your employee, you will pay us 10%, or the percentage as otherwise agreed between you and us, of the Job Seeker's first-year base salary ("Success Fee"). A Success Fee will be payable even if the Job Seeker is Engaged for a role, team, or function different from the role originally discussed at the time of Introduction.

**Refund Guarantee:** If a Job Seeker you engage as an employee leaves the Engagement due to resignation (except where arising from misconduct, breach of contract by the Hirer) or dismissal (except where dismissal results from any cause unrelated to the Job Seeker's performance or conduct) within the first three (3) months of their start date, we will provide a full cash refund of the Success Fee.

To be eligible, you must notify us in writing of the early termination within 14 days of it occurring. The refund will be processed to the original payment method within 30 days of your notification.

**Re-engagement:** For the avoidance of doubt, a Success Fee remains payable if a Job Seeker is Engaged within twelve (12) months of Introduction, regardless of whether the Job Seeker was previously rejected, not progressed, or considered unsuccessful for any role.

**Success fee (contractors):** **Calculation:** If the Job Seeker does not become your employee but you Engage them otherwise (including as a contractor), you will pay us 10% of the total fees and rates paid or payable to the Job Seeker (or any intermediary) during the term of the Engagement, including any renewal or extension, up to a maximum of twelve (12) months ("Success Fee"). A Success Fee will be payable even if the Job Seeker is Engaged for a role, team, or function different from the role originally discussed at the time of Introduction.

**Conversion to an employee:** If during the twelve (12) months following the commencement of an Engagement, the Job Seeker becomes your employee (a "Conversion"), a Success Fee shall be payable to us with respect to that Job Seeker, less any fees previously paid under the previous Engagement. Any remaining balance of the Success Fee shall be invoiced in accordance with our payment terms below.

**Invoicing mechanism:** If you Engage a Job Seeker on a contractor, part-time, or temporary basis, you agree to promptly provide us with copies of the approved timesheets and/or invoices submitted by the Job Seeker (or any intermediary) at the end of each calendar month or upon receipt, whichever occurs sooner. Based on such information, we will issue an invoice for the Success Fee, which shall be payable in accordance with the Payment Terms. If you fail to provide the required documentation in a timely manner, we reserve the right to invoice based on our reasonable estimates, subject to later adjustment.

**Re-engagement:** For the avoidance of doubt, a Success Fee remains payable if a Job Seeker is Engaged within twelve (12) months of Introduction, regardless of whether the Job Seeker was previously rejected, not progressed, or considered unsuccessful for any role.

**Success fee (other engagements):** **Scope:** This section applies where you Engage a Job Seeker on a basis that is neither employment nor an engagement for ascertainable fees or rates (a "Non-Standard Engagement"). Examples include a co-founder or equity-only Engagement, an unpaid or voluntary opportunity, an internship, an apprenticeship, or a programme- or bootcamp-participant Engagement. Where a Non-Standard Engagement would otherwise fall within the Success fee (contractors) section, this section applies to the exclusion of that section.

**Calculation:** For a Non-Standard Engagement, a flat Success Fee of £2,500 (exclusive of VAT) shall be payable ("Success Fee"). For the avoidance of doubt, this Success Fee remains payable notwithstanding that the Job Seeker receives no, nominal, or non-cash (for example, equity-only) compensation from you.

**Uplift on conversion:** If, within twelve (12) months of the Introduction, the Job Seeker becomes your employee or is Engaged on a basis for which there are ascertainable fees or rates, the Success Fee applicable under the Success fee (employees) or Success fee (contractors) section (as applicable) shall become payable, less the flat Success Fee already paid under this section. Any remaining balance shall be invoiced in accordance with the Payment Terms.

**No refund:** The Refund Guarantee does not apply to a Success Fee payable under this section.

**Invoicing:** The flat Success Fee under this section shall be invoiced in accordance with the Payment Terms and is not subject to the timesheet or invoice-based mechanism applicable to contractor Engagements.

**Payment terms:** **Payment within 14 days:** You will pay us the Success Fee in the currency we invoice you in within 14 days of receiving an invoice from us. We may issue the invoice on the date the Job Seeker's employment contract (or contractor agreement) is signed by both you and the Job Seeker, or on the date we become aware of such Engagement, whichever is earlier. If you are late in paying our invoice, we may charge you annual interest of 8% above the Bank of England's base interest rate.

### 5C. Payment, taxes and late payment (all Hirers)

**Payment method:** for a Plan you must keep a valid payment method on file, which, by accepting these Terms, you authorise us and our payment processor to charge for each Subscription Fee, whether monthly or annual, together with any pro-rata charge and any overage at the Overage Rate as they fall due. We use Stripe to process card payments and do not store your card details ourselves.

**Failed payments:** if a charge fails we may retry it over the following 14 days and will tell you if we do this. If it remains unpaid after that period we may suspend your access to the Platform until it is paid. Suspension does not extend the Billing Period or give rise to any right of refund.

**Calculation of late fees:** If any amount you owe is not paid by its due date, interest will accrue daily on the overdue sum at 8% per annum above the Bank of England's base interest rate until paid in full. We may issue periodic invoices for accrued interest, and you must pay each such invoice together with any outstanding Subscription Fee or Success Fee within 14 days of receipt. If not paid within this period, interest will continue to accrue on all overdue amounts. We may take legal or other recovery action to recover all sums owed, including reasonable costs of recovery, for overdue amounts unpaid for 90 days after the original due date.

**Taxes:** All fees are exclusive of VAT (if applicable). You must pay us VAT (if applicable) if included on the invoice. All fees are also exclusive of US federal, state and local sales, use and similar taxes. Where we are required to collect such taxes we will add them to your invoice, and where you claim an exemption you must give us a valid exemption certificate before the charge falls due. Each party is responsible for its own income taxes.

### 5D. Changing Pricing Model (all Hirers)

We may change your Pricing Model for certain reasons, and at our discretion.

Your account runs on one Pricing Model at a time: either a Plan under section 5A, or success-fee pricing under section 5B. We may move your account between these Pricing Models if needed: for example, where your hiring moves between regions, where the pricing we offer in your market changes, or where the Pricing Model you are on no longer fits how you use the Platform.

**Notice, and your right to leave:** where we start the change we will give you at least thirty (30) days' written notice, and the change takes effect at the start of the first Billing Period that begins at least thirty (30) days after we send that notice. You may cancel your Plan or stop using the Platform before the change takes effect rather than accept it.

**What a move onto a Plan covers:** unless we agree otherwise in writing, a Plan applies to the roles you open after the move. Roles that are already live when the move happens stay on success-fee pricing until you close them, together with every Introduction already made for them. A Plan is not a way to reprice a hire you are already close to making.

Every Engagement is billed under the Pricing Model that applied when we made the Introduction; so that a Job Seeker already Introduced to you still carries a Success Fee if you Engage them within twelve (12) months, whatever Pricing Model you move onto afterwards, and a Job Seeker first Introduced to you under a Plan is never subject to a Success Fee. Section 6 (Pre-existing Candidates) and the disclosure duty in section 7 apply to any Introductions that carry a Success Fee but not to the others.

**Money already paid:** moving between Pricing Models does not refund a Subscription Fee for a Billing Period you have already paid for. Where you move from a Plan to success-fee pricing, your Plan runs to the end of that Billing Period and success-fee pricing starts the day after, so that you are never paying for both Pricing Models for the same day. Where you move from success-fee pricing to a Plan, any Success Fee already invoiced or accrued remains payable.

**Slots and allowances on the way out:** when a Plan ends because you have moved to success-fee pricing, section 5A governs what happens to Intro Requests still pending, and unused Usage Allowance is not carried over, refunded or credited.

## 6\. Pre-existing Candidates

This section applies only to Hirers on success-fee pricing. It has no effect while you are on a Plan, because no Success Fee arises.

A Success Fee will not be due if a Job Seeker was already in your active recruitment pipeline prior to our Introduction. An "active recruitment pipeline" is defined as substantive engagement evidenced by one of the following, occurring within six months prior to our Introduction: (a) a direct application from the Job Seeker to you for a similar role; or (b) substantive, two-way communication between you and the Job Seeker regarding a potential role with your organisation.

For clarity, internal discussions, recruiter notes, database records, passive sourcing activity, speculative outreach, or unilateral communications that did not receive a substantive response from the Job Seeker do not constitute an active recruitment pipeline.

For the avoidance of doubt, where you engage with a Sourced Candidate prior to that individual becoming a Job Seeker, and that individual subsequently becomes a Job Seeker and an Introduction is made, the provisions of this clause shall apply.

To claim this exception, you must notify us in writing (to [legal@jackandjill.ai](mailto:legal@jackandjill.ai)) within ten (10) business days after an Introduction is made or upon request and provide reasonable written evidence (of the type described above) that the Job Seeker was already in your active recruitment pipeline. If you do not notify us within this timeframe, our Introduction will be deemed the effective cause of the Engagement, and the Success Fee will be payable in full upon Engaging the Job Seeker in accordance with these Terms.

For the avoidance of doubt, an Introduction is deemed to have been made when we have shared a Job Seeker's information with you by or on behalf of Jack & Jill in any way, and you have not exercised your right to an exception for the relevant Job Seeker under this clause.

## 7\. Your obligations

**Disclose Engagements:** This obligation applies only to Hirers on success-fee pricing. You must notify us promptly if you or an Affiliate make an offer of employment or Engage a Job Seeker within twelve (12) months of the Introduction, including whether or not that offer is accepted or later withdrawn, and disclose to us the Job Seeker's first-year base salary (where the Job Seeker is Engaged as an employee), or where the Job Seeker is Engaged other than as an employee (including as a contractor), the total fees and rates paid or payable to the Job Seeker (or any intermediary) during the term of the Engagement, including any renewal or extension, contract terms and any extension or renewal of their Engagement (including whether they become your employee in the first twelve (12) months of the Engagement).

If you fail or refuse to provide complete and accurate compensation details, we reserve the right to invoice you based on our reasonable estimate of the applicable compensation, which shall be binding unless proven manifestly incorrect.

**Tell us about hires anyway:** if you are on a Plan we ask you to mark in the Platform when you Engage a Job Seeker. This costs you nothing, is not a condition of your Plan, and lets us close the role, stop Jill working it, and tell the other candidates. Withholding it does not create a fee but it does impact the service for you and for Job Seekers.

**Accurate information:** Your Information must be accurate and up-to-date and not be incomplete or misleading. For Hirers on success-fee pricing this includes information about Job Seekers you hired, their salary and any extension of their Engagement.

**No illegal or harmful information:** Your Information must not include anything that is illegal or harmful, or which may disrupt the Platform or violate its security.

**Be respectful:** Do not bully, insult, intimidate or humiliate others when using the Platform. Avoid defamatory, obscene, offensive, hateful or inflammatory behaviour.

**No disruptive use:** Do not disrupt, hack, introduce viruses or malicious code to, interfere with security of, reverse engineer, tamper with, scrape or otherwise harvest or infer information from the Platform. Do not upload roles where you are not genuinely looking to Engage Job Seekers.

**No recruiter or agency use:** You represent and warrant that you are an end employer using the Platform solely to hire for your own internal roles, and not a recruitment agency, staffing firm, headhunter, or other intermediary acting on behalf of third parties. The only exception is for embedded recruiters or recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) providers who are registered using an email address on their client company's domain (e.g., name@clientcompany.com), which serves as evidence of authorisation to recruit on that company's behalf. Such users may only use the Platform to hire for that specific company's internal roles. You may not use the Platform to source, assess, or introduce Job Seekers for third parties or for inclusion in external talent networks. This restriction is necessary to protect the integrity of the Platform, prevent conflicts of interest, and safeguard Job Seeker data. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access if we reasonably believe this obligation has been breached.

**One organisation per account:** your Plan, its Slots and its Usage Allowances are for hiring by your own organisation and its Affiliates. You must not share, resell, sublicense or otherwise make your account or any Jill available to another organisation, or use a Slot to fill a role that is not yours, whether or not you charge for doing so. This replaces, for Hirers on a Plan, the fee-avoidance concern addressed by the anti-circumvention clause below.

**No competitive use:** Do not use the Platform or Suggestions to create, market or distribute any product or service that is similar or competitive to the Platform, or engage in any competitive analysis of the Platform. We reserve the right to remove competitors from our platform based on risk of competitive use.

**No third-party introductions:** Introductions of Job Seekers are confidential and for your internal hiring purposes only. You may not disclose, share, or forward any Job Seeker's details to any third party. Any such disclosure will be deemed a Third-Party Introduction (meaning any act that enables a third party to identify, contact, or Engage a Job Seeker). Where you are on a Plan, a Third-Party Introduction is a material breach of these Terms and we may suspend or terminate your access, and you must indemnify us under section 13 for any loss it causes, including to a Job Seeker. Where you are on success-fee pricing, if that disclosure results in an Engagement of the Job Seeker by a third party within twelve (12) months of our Introduction, you will be liable for payment of the applicable Success Fee as if you had Engaged the Job Seeker directly, and no refund or offset shall apply in any circumstances.

**Anti-circumvention:** This clause applies only to Hirers on success-fee pricing. You must not, and must ensure that your Affiliates do not, directly or indirectly circumvent these Terms for the purpose of avoiding payment of any fees due to us. If you, any Affiliate, or any related party Engages a Job Seeker whom we Introduced to you within twelve (12) months of the date of Introduction, you shall be liable to pay us the applicable Success Fee as if you had Engaged the Job Seeker directly. No refund shall apply in respect of any Engagement arising from a breach of this clause.

**No gaming of allowances:** you must not create multiple accounts, use multiple email domains, or cancel and re-subscribe in order to obtain more than one free tier or more than one Usage Allowance for the same organisation. Where we reasonably believe this has happened we may merge or suspend the accounts and invoice you for the Plan you would otherwise have paid for.

**Keep login details confidential:** Keep your Platform login details confidential and do not disclose them to anyone. You must notify us immediately if you suspect or become aware of any unauthorised use of your login details or any other breach of security.

**Comply with law:** Comply with all laws and regulations when using the Platform, and Engaging Job Seekers we Introduced to you. Do not use the Platform in any way that is unlawful.

**Responsibility for hires:** You are fully responsible for any decision to Engage a Job Seeker.

The Platform is powered by AI. Do not rely on any Suggestion provided by Jill (including to Engage a Job Seeker) without prior human intervention, review and approval by a suitably qualified and skilled member of your team.

Please also review the End User Licence Agreement which applies to your use of the Platform.

## 8\. Subcontracting

**We may use subcontractors:** We use third parties (including AI providers of the models that power the Platform) to perform our obligations under these Terms and we may share Your Information with these third parties to the extent necessary to provide our services and the Platform. This includes Stripe, which processes payments for Plans.

**You will comply with our subcontractors' policies:** When using the Platform, you agree to comply with OpenAI's Service Terms, Sharing & Publication Policy and Usage Policies, Anthropic's Acceptable Use Policy, Google's Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy, ElevenLabs's Prohibited Use Policy, and any other applicable AI policies and guidelines we notify to you from time to time.

## 9\. Our right to make changes

**Changes to the Platform:** We may change the Platform from time to time to reflect user feedback or our business priorities. We will give you reasonable notice of any material changes, being changes that we reasonably consider may affect your rights or obligations under these terms. Where a change materially reduces a Usage Allowance included in your Plan, we will give you at least thirty (30) days' notice and you may cancel before it takes effect.

**Updates to these Terms:** We may update these Terms from time to time. If we do, we will post an updated version of these Terms on the Platform.
